description: This Java class 'AcksUpdater' manages local acknowledgement labels in a distributed pub/sub system, handling subscription validation, DData updates, and reacting to cluster changes.

classes.name: AcksUpdater
classes.description: Actor class managing acknowledgement labels, handling subscription logic, DData updates, and reacting to cluster events.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for actor instantiation with configuration, subscriber, and distributed data access.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling behavior, including reacting to DData changes and cluster member removal.

methods.name: getDDataWriter
methods.description: Provides access to the DData writer for updates.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription requests, validating labels and topics, and setting up watchers.

methods.name: ddataOpSuccess
methods.description: Logs unexpected DData operation success events.

methods.name: onChanged
methods.description: Processes changes from the replicator, identifying local subscribers that lost race conditions.

methods.name: failSubscribe
methods.description: Notifies a subscriber of failure due to label conflicts.

methods.name: areAckLabelsDeclaredHere
methods.description: Checks if acknowledgment labels are already declared by a subscriber.

methods.name: getLocalLosers
methods.description: Identifies local subscribers who lost race conditions based on remote acknowledgment claims.

methods.name: areTopicsClaimedRemotely
methods.description: Checks if topics are claimed by remote acknowledgment labels.

methods.name: isSmallerThanMySubscriber
methods.description: Compares subscriber references to determine ordering.
